cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 48% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +1.31% · WTI +0.58% · Brent +0.96% · NatGas +2.52%. 48% of 67 energy names are green — a mixed, rotational tape. Refining & Downstream is doing the heavy lifting at +1.56%.

cards.headline: Refining & Downstream leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Refining & Downstream at +1.56%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.60%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at -6.03%
cards.body: Leaders: EQNR +2.37%, PSX +2.13%, APA +1.84%, OXY +1.66%, XOM +1.49%. Laggards: EOSE -6.03%, BE -5.78%, OKLO -4.10%, FLNC -3.94%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
